chunks: Al-Faqih: Melalui sanadnya kepada Ali ibn Riab, dari Abi Basir, dari Abi Ja'far (alamah) yang berkata:

Rasulullah (shalat dan salam atasnya dan keluarganya), Amirul Mukminin (shalat dan salam atasnya), dan Marthad ibn Abi Marthad al-Ghanawi berbagi seekor unta di antara mereka saat dalam perjalanan menuju Badr.

key_terms.بَدْرٍ: Badr, lokasi pertempuran besar pertama dalam Islam
key_terms.مَرْثَدُ بْنُ أَبِي مَرْثَدٍ الْغَنَوِيُ: Marthad ibn Abi Marthad al-Ghanawi, seorang sahabat Nabi
key_terms.يَعْقُبُونَ: Bergiliran (dalam menunggang atau melakukan suatu tindakan)

ai.seo_question: Siapa yang berbagi unta dengan Nabi dan Imam Ali selama perjalanan ke Badr?
ai.summary: Hadith highlights the humility and shared hardship of the Prophet (SAW), Imam Ali (AS), and Marthad ibn Abi Marthad during their journey to Badr, illustrating the practical application of *ta'qib* (taking turns riding a single camel). It serves as a key narrative in Shia scholarship to demonstrate the close spiritual and physical bond between the Ahl al-Bayt and their companions, emphasizing that leadership in Islam is characterized by accessibility and equality in adversity.
